description: This file defines a React component named ActiveWeekCard, which displays information about an active contest for a specific week, including the week label, date range, participants, unique voters, and time remaining until contest ends. It imports React, a Card component, and a CSS stylesheet for styling.

methods.name: ActiveWeekCard({ context })
methods.description: React functional component that renders a styled card displaying the active contest information based on the provided context props.
